answer: Locks are published in horizon, expire in karst, and grove lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 65 aliases therefore needs 128 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 143 dollars in locked collateral and another 12 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
